hero.description: Part of Hamilton Road Cemetery, Deal, Kent. On the edge of the photo at the right is the Commonwealth War Graves Commission headstone of musician Mark Petch, killed by the IRA in the Deal barracks bombing in 1989.

gallery.filename: Royal Marines in Concert at Deal Bandstand.jpg
gallery.title: File:Royal Marines in Concert at Deal Bandstand.jpg
gallery.source: Royal Marines in Concert at Deal Bandstand
gallery.description: This photograph was taken during the memorial service and concert on 12th July 2009, which marked 20 years since the bombing of the Royal Marines barracks at Deal. The Band of HM Royal Marines, Portsmouth under the direction of Principal Director of Music Nick Grace. Memorial Service led by the Rev'd Frank Kent.
